messages:
anya: eval-ci flagged a regression in nightly: KGQA promptset shows +18% hallucination vs baseline. attaching summary csv and sample generations. link: https://ci.internal/reports/1717567890

eval-ci: nightly-run 2024-11-09 03:07 UTC — model: redwood-llama-v2-2.1-int8 (canary profile). metrics: exact-match -2.1%, hallucination_rate +18%, per-prompt failures: 8/50 (kgqa_main subset).

sam: ack — putting this in triage. assigning @miguel and @kira. can you reproduce locally with the same quant profile?

miguel: looking now. quick note: failure pattern looks like span hallucinations where answers include unrelated entities. sample: "Q: Who invented the fast Fourier transform? A: John von Neumann introduced FFT as part of spectral analysis" (ground truth: Cooley & Tukey).

kira: omg that sample is rough. initial guess: int8 quant kernel change from last infra patch? we rolled a new fused-attn kernel on 2024-11-08 22:10 UTC.

miguel: reproducing with docker image redwood/inference:canary-20241108 + same quant table. command: 
```
python eval/run_eval.py --model redwood-llama-v2-2.1-int8 --promptset kgqa_main --seed 42 --batch 8 --quant-profile canary-20241108
```
Got same +~17% hallucination.

anya: good repro. hypothesis: quantized attention kernel introduced small token alignment drift that affects multi-hop QA prompts. why only KGQA subset? maybe they rely on strict pattern matching or special tokens.

sam: next steps: compare logits and attention maps between baseline (v2.0-int8 + stable kernels) and canary. miguel can you dump kv/attn for a failing example?

miguel: dumped logs (small excerpt):
```
# baseline logits token ids around answer start
baseline: [ ... 345, 1024, 51, 78 ... ]
# canary logits (shifted probability mass)
canary:   [ ... 345, 1024, 59, 12 ... ]
# attention diag: prefix tokens show reduced head-2 weight to question tokens (~0.12 -> 0.03)
```
seems like head distribution changed for early layers.

kira: that points to kernel numerical differences (fp32->int8 kernel reorder, fused ops). also check special-token handling: did tokenizers change? tokenization drift would show different token ids.

miguel: token ids identical in repro. so tokenization not the cause.

anya: file a root-cause hypothesis: fused-attn int8 kernel introduces tiny numerical reordering -> attention head redistribution -> downstream generation drift on prompts sensitive to attention patterns. severity higher on KGQA because of multi-span dependency.

sam: agree. mitigation plan proposals:
- immediate rollback of fused-attn kernel on canary infra
- pin quant-profile for nightly evals to stable profile (v2.0-int8) until root cause fixed
- add a gating rule in nightly CI: hallucination_rate must be within +5% of baseline or fail block
- run a focused canary that ramps int8-kernel on 5% of nightly eval shards and compare diffs

kira: I'll open infra PR to revert kernel on canary clusters and add rollout pause. also adding monitoring: per-head attention distribution diffs.

deploy-bot: started rollback: infra/fused-attn-kernel -> rollback to kernel-stable-20241021 on canary nodes. triggered at 2024-11-09T04:12:10Z.

deploy-bot: rollback completed on canary pool (3 nodes). healthchecks green.

miguel: re-ran the exact same eval with kernel-stable + redwood-llama-v2-2.1-int8: hallucination back down to +2% over baseline (within noise). reproduces baseline behavior.

anya: excellent — this supports kernel as root cause.

sam: created issue RM-1242 with RCA notes and assigned to infra/kernel team. action items in the issue:
- bisect kernel changes to identify the offending transform (expected 1-2 commits)
- add FP32 reference tests for head weight stats during unit tests
- add gating rule: any kernel merge that alters per-head attention distribution >0.05 avg must be flagged and require approval

kira: also adding an eval-level gating: nightly will now include kgqa_main in a strict gate that fails CI if hallucination_rate > baseline+5%. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/evals/pulls/987

product-ops: noting impact: we had a few internal tickets tied to KGQA results this morning. we'll communicate to early access customers that we paused canary and reverted. no customer-facing incidents.

miguel: follow-up tests I'll run:
- numeric gradient check across fused vs stable kernels on a 16-sample set
- run quantize tune with alternative clipping thresholds to see if that mitigates
- instrument per-layer random seeds to rule out nondeterminism

anya: timeline:
- 04:12 rollback done (short-term mitigated)
- by EOD today: infra will bisect and try a patched kernel on internal canary (miguel + kira)
- by tomorrow morning: gating rule merged into nightly CI; evals pinned to stable quant-profile until verified

sam: leaving notes for postmortem: cause, detection (nightly), mitigation (rollback+gates), follow-ups (kernel test additions). will schedule 30-min RCA sync at 16:00 UTC today.

kira: adding reproducibility artifacts to the issue (scripts + seeds + sample ids).

anya: thanks all. if anyone finds more failing families beyond kgqa_main, @channel ping. :eyes:

eval-ci: nightly alert closed (regression reverted by rollback).
